parameters.name: ClusterCNNFStatus
parameters.description:
The container firewall status of the cluster. Valid values:
- **-1**: unknown
- **0**: abnormal
- **1**: normal
- **2**: normal pending confirmation

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.
>You can call the [DescribeContainerInstances](~~DescribeContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: ExcludeClusterTypes
parameters.description: The list of excluded cluster types.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20.
